status: synthetic model check (UNVERIFIED call and review parameters; measured detector); not a research result
posterior_evaluated_at: the time of each candidate's last evidence (not the end of the horizon), so the calibration table excludes the decay a candidate suffers while nothing further confirms it
calibration_label: a candidate counts as real if it holds any genuine evidence, which is stricter than the hypothesis H1 (an incident occurred anywhere in its region during its window)

detector_masking.definition: alternating renewal: an Exp(lambda) armed spell, then a fixed cooldown. Incident arrivals are independent of camera state, so by PASTA the time-average armed fraction is also P(armed when a crash happens).
detector_masking.ci_basis: corners of the committed detection and false-alarm CIs in results/vision/sim_inputs.yaml (not a joint interval)
